title: GRUMMAN FLXIBLE CORP.: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:DOOR AND SIDE (140 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY CONTAIN EMERGENCY ESCAPE WINDOWS THAT DO NOT COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 217, "BUS WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE". EXCESSIVE FORCE MAY BE REQUIRED TO OPEN THESE WINDOWS.

title: Dakota Manufacturing Co., Inc.: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY (9 affected)
summary: THE TIRES OF THE FRONT AXLE ASSEMBLY MAY COME INTO CONTACT WITH A FLOOR SUPPORT CROSSMEMBER AND LIMITED TIRE CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE FRONT TIRES AND THE WOOD DECKING WILL RESULT. WHEN TRAILER IS LOADED THE TIRE WILL RUB AGAINST THE SUPPORT CROSSMEMBER CAUSING TIRE DAMAGE OR FAILURE. SHOULD THE LOAD HAVE A HIGH CENTER OF GRAVITY THE TRAILER MAY SWAY, CAUSING THE TIRES TO COME INTO CONTACT WITH THE WOOD DECKING.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: LIGHTING:GENERAL COMPONENT:EMERGENCY FLASHING HAZA (2,000 affected)
summary: THE TURN SIGNAL FLASHERS DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT". THESE SIGNALS DO NOT MEET THE REQUIRED FLASH RATE AND "CURRENT ON" TIME SPECIFIED.

title: Strick Trailers, LLC: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:AIR:LINES AND FITTINGS (295 affected)
summary: THE TRAILERS HAVE INCORRECT CONNECTIONS BETWEEN THE SUPPLY LINE AND THE DOLLY. THIS IMPROPER CONNECTION PREVENTS THE DOLLY AND FULL TRAILER FROM HAVING THE ABILITY TO PERFORM EMERGENCY BRAKING OR PARKING BRAKE FUNCTIONS.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:UNKNOWN TYPE:LINE:HOSE (1,167 affected)
summary: THE FUEL INLET PIPE MAY DEVELOP CRACKS AT THE FLARED END LEADING INTO THE CARBURETOR DUE TO VIBRATIONS IN OPERATION. THESE CRACKS COULD RESULT IN FUEL LEAKAGE.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY:SHAFT AXLE (8,881 affected)
summary: THE REAR AXLE SHAFTS RECEIVED IMPROPER HEAT TREATMENT DURING MANUFACTURE. THE SHAFT MAY BREAK AND THE TIRE AND WHEEL ASSEMBLY COULD DISENGAGE FROM THE VEHICLE.

title: PETERBILT MOTOR COMPANY: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:BUCKET:BACK REST (5,000 affected)
summary: THE SEAT BACK ADJUSTMENT MOUNTING BRACKETS INSTALLED ON SOME VEHICLES MAY CRACK. THIS MAY LEAD TO SEPARATION OF THE SEAT FRAME FROM THE SEAT BACK.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN (368 affected)
summary: THE STEERING PITMAN ARM CROSS BOLTS ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED TO PROPERLY SECURE THE ARM TO THE STEERING GEAR SHAFT. THE BOLT MAY LOOSEN FURTHER DURING CONTINUED VEHICLE OPERATION.
